metadata.body:
Require argument and return signatures compatible with typed advice bindings. This prevents incompatible overloads and erased bridge methods from receiving advice, including SQS builder bridges, Couchbase encoders, and Eclipse OSGi dynamic imports.

This is the binding-safety slice of #20475, with regression coverage and the required test wiring. Signature compatibility is handled in #20492; the remaining matcher broadening stays deferred in #20475.

Part of #20103.
